newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares edge higher as month-end nears.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares edge higher as month-end nears.

text.p: 1725 GMT - Portuguese shares edged higher as investment and pension funds bought stocks to square portfolios towards month-end, dealers said. Rights in the restructuring of Sonae Investimentos were heavily sought after, they said. Turnover on Lisbon bourse was a relatively low 6.2 billion escudos. Dealers said that funds could push up the value of their portfolios tomorrow on the last trading day of the month.
* BPI shares were steady a day after the announcement of a 56 percent hike in 1996 profits. BPI closed at 2,550 escudos, up 50, in volume of 51,644 shares.
* Ship repairer Lisnave was well-supported around 390 escudos. The stock was battered recently after its announcement of a drastic reduction in its capital as part of a restructuring.
